api_info.title: Sports Photo Gallery — Local Owner API
api_info.description: Proposed versioned contract for the private desktop owner manager. Express binds 127.0.0.1:5000; the same-origin local frontend proxies /api and /media. All manager reads and writes are private, except the guarded local session bootstrap which does not require its own bearer token. Public hosting serves static manifests and immutable photo assets only, not this API, tokens, drafts, database, or raw EXIF. This specification is a contract review, not proof that concurrent implementation satisfies it. The unpublished, unversioned prototype is replaced; no external clients have been verified.

Scorecard: D / 67.65, below B; exits 1. Do not invent HTTPS on loopback, pagination, filtering, hypermedia, OAuth or extra flat error fields to game the generic score.

Full-album arrays are intentionally unpaginated. Static public album manifests are fetched once and cached; initial 36-photo rendering is the requested frontend contract, not proof of runtime implementation or server pagination.
